intro: Zaldimar Wefhellt is a human mage trainer stationed on the upper floor of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. He serves as an instructor for fledgling spellcasters passing through Elwynn Forest before sending them along to higher practitioners in Stormwind City.

p: While Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn is best known for weary travelers, rowdy adventurers, and local gossip, its upper rooms house instructors of various trades. Tucked into one of the second-floor chambers, Zaldimar Wefhellt instructs novice mages in the foundational arts of the arcane, fire, and frost. Once an apprentice outgrows his early tutelage, he directs them north to the Mage Quarter in Stormwind to study under Jennea Cannon.
